note: Measured on 2026-09-14 against gameplay-export pack v10 (/mnt/archive/datasets/melee/skirmish-gameplay/v10-snapshot-20260913/fox-bf), after the repository owner's src/characters restructure (docs/architecture.md, docs/luau.md).
